Aisha (partnerships): Quick sync — we're updating the cost model for Redwood's marketplace listing and need canonical numbers from you for reserved vs ephemeral (spot) supply. Can you confirm per-SKU prices, commitment lengths, preemption profiles, and any minimums/lead times? Ideally a small CSV or snippet we can drop straight into the model.
CoreWeave Rep: Yep — happy to share. Attaching a compact table below with typical commercial terms we offer to infra partners (US region, list prices before marketplace fee):
```
sku,gpu_type,reserved_1yr_usd_per_gpu_hour,reserved_3yr_usd_per_gpu_hour,spot_effective_usd_per_gpu_hour,avg_spot_preempt_rate,lead_time_days,min_commit_gpus
cw-a100-80g,A100-80GB,1.10,0.85,0.32,0.12,14,8
cw-h100-80g,H100-80GB,2.40,1.85,0.68,0.18,21,4
cw-a10g,A10G-24GB,0.45,0.38,0.12,0.08,7,16
```
CoreWeave Rep: Notes: reserved_* are committed price assuming monthly billing and 1:1 reservation (no sharing). Spot_effective is historical average after reclamation and transient discounts — includes short windows where jobs paused. Preempt_rate is observed % of spot instances reclaimed within a 24h window. Lead times are typical for large commits (smaller orders often faster).
Ben (finance): Thanks. For modeling we convert to $/GPU-hour at 100% uptime; then apply utilization. What's your suggested realistic utilization for reserved pools if we're running mixed workloads?
CoreWeave Rep: Customers running long-running model serving see 75–85% utilization on reserved pools on average; new customers earlier 60–70%. For conservative modeling use 70% base, and 80% for growth scenarios.
Devon (pricing): We need to account for marketplace listing fee (we're planning 12% rev share) and a potential 5% co-marketing credit for initial quarter. Also are there any tiered discounts for >500 GPU-months?
CoreWeave Rep: Yes — tier discounts kick in at scale. Quick rule-of-thumb: 0% <500, 8% 500–2000, 15% >2000 GPU-months. We can provide a formal price ladder if you want.
Carlos (supply): Curious about spot distribution: are preemptions bursty or uniform? For our autoscaler/eviction strategy we need hourly distribution (not just daily rate).
CoreWeave Rep: Preemptions are bursty around maintenance windows and occasionally during marketplace demand spikes. Rough distribution: 40% of preemptions happen in a 2–3 hour window each week (maintenance), 60% spread throughout the week. We'll share a sample histogram in CSV if helpful.
Eve (eng-ops): For capacity modeling — do you expose regional capacity caps per SKU? We need per-region avail to avoid overallocating for low-latency customers in EU/APAC.
CoreWeave Rep: Yes, regional caps vary. Quick note: US has ~60% of capacity for H100 family, EU ~25%, APAC ~15% (subject to change as we add pods). We recommend modeling a rolling 10% safety buffer by region.
Aisha (partnerships): This is great — actionable. Two asks: (1) Can you send a single CSV with the sku rows + the tier ladder + a simple preempt histogram attached (one file) by EOD PT? (2) Please include whether committed contracts allow bursting to spot for overflow and how billing works when bursting (do we prorate reserved price vs spot)?
CoreWeave Rep: Yes on CSV, will send by EOD PT. Bursting: reserved customers may burst into spot in the same region; billing is: reserved units billed at committed price for reserved hours used, spot billed at spot price for burst hours. If underlying reserved machines are used to serve burst traffic (i.e., overcommit), we'll discuss overflow credits case-by-case.
Ben (finance): Once we have the CSV I will run the $/GPU-hour -> $/token conversions with our latency-weighted utilization assumptions and share a draft model. Will also simulate 3 scenarios: conservative (60% util), baseline (70%), aggressive (80%).
Devon (pricing): Heads-up: for the marketplace we may add a small platform uplift (10–15% gross) to cover orchestration + support. We'll validate against the draft.
Aisha (partnerships): Perfect. Thanks everyone. CoreWeave Rep — tagging you: @CoreWeave Rep. If you can include any contractual minimums/early-termination terms in the CSV that'd be super helpful.
CoreWeave Rep: Got it — will include min commit, ET clauses brief. Expect the file shortly. :thumbsup:
